DD_PRIMARY_OUTPUT_DESC: Display output name as reported by xrandr, for example HDMI-1. This display keeps the regular Volumio kiosk and the touchscreen. Leave empty and the smaller display is picked, going by the physical size xrandr reports.
DD_SECONDARY_OUTPUT_DESC: The other display. Leave empty to detect automatically.
DD_DOUBLE_TAP_TIME_DESC: Seconds between two taps for them to count as a double tap. A double tap turns the visualizer on and off. Visualizer is x86 only. Default: 0.3
DD_TAP_ZONE_DESC: When the visualizer runs on the second display, presets are changed only by tapping this part of the front panel, where the album art sits. Given as a fraction of display width. Default: 0.33
DD_LOOPBACK_OUT_DESC: ALSA device the audio copy is written to. Run aplay -l to find the Loopback card number. Keep the plughw prefix: it lets ALSA convert the sample format, otherwise whichever side opens the loopback first locks the format and the other one fails.
DD_AUDIO_DEVICE_DESC: Device number the visualizer listens on. Run projectMSDL --listAudioDevices and pick Loopback PCM (2). Default: 2
DD_AUTO_CHANGE_DESC: Off: a preset stays until you tap for the next one. On: presets change by themselves at the interval below.
DD_PRESET_DURATION_DESC: Seconds each preset stays on screen when presets change automatically. Default: 30
DD_TRANSITION_DESC: Seconds of smooth blending from one preset to the next. 0 switches instantly. Default: 3
DD_BEAT_DESC: How strongly the picture reacts to the beat. Lower is calmer, higher is livelier. From 0 to 2. Default: 1
DD_FPS_DESC: Frames per second. Lower it if the picture stutters or the fan gets loud. Default: 60
